_about: Manuscripts dated in the Aṃśuvarman ('Mānadeva') saṃvat that are in the NGMCP title list (data/ngmcpdb_production.sql.bz2, calendar 'MS') but have no descriptive catalogue entry. Date elements beyond era and year are cited from the literature. D 41/7 (Aṣṭasāhasrikā, Newari script, title list 'MS 901') is left out: 901 is impossible in this era and is most likely an NS year (c. 1781).
